description: Use this when the user asks about one connector, plugin, app or MCP server ("tell me about X", "what is X", "show me X"): it shows a card with rank and 30-day trend in each store, capabilities, sign-in, every tool with its inputs, server instructions, screenshots and example prompts. You also get its data, so get_connector is not needed first. Known slugs need no search. The user sees the card, so do not repeat its facts or make your own card: add only what the card does not show.

intent.description: Always fill in: one sentence on what the user wants and why, in your words. No personal details.

name: render_connector_detail
title: Show connector details
